Container.Name: hera
Container.Overview: Hera is a self-hosted music recommendation and automated downloader service powered by Last.fm, YouTube Music, and Downtify. Discover new music tailored to your listening taste, download tracks, albums, or playlists, and synchronize your local music library.
Container.Description:
Hera is a self-hosted music recommendation and automated downloader service powered by Last.fm, YouTube Music, and Downtify.
Features: - Automated Nightly Downloads: Automatically fetch tailored recommendations and download new tracks up to a daily limit. - Direct Song & Artist Search: Search songs across YouTube Music with instant details and one-click downloading. - Link & Stream Ingestion: Paste Spotify or YouTube Music links (tracks, albums, playlists) for automated ingestion. - Intelligent Deduplication: Multi-tier indexing across local files to avoid duplicate downloads. - Real-time Dashboard: Minimalist web interface with live progress bars and WebSocket feed.
Note: Requires the Downtify companion container (henriquesebastiao/downtify) accessible on the network.
Container.Requires: Requires Downtify (henriquesebastiao/downtify) running and accessible on the network on port 8000.
